parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for a Node.js ESM implementation of the Python base58 script, manual command-line parsing for --a/--b/--c/--d, byte-style output matching Python print(bytes), local .mjs modules, no external dependencies, and no Buffer or Uint8Array use.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite being in swarm mode, the main actor declared the task small and self-contained and kept all probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final response work under itself; status confirms no executed delegation.
parallel.implementation: Wrote a seven-file structure: alphabet lookup, UTF-8 encoder, Base58 encode, Base58 decode, bytes repr helper, CLI parser, and test15.mjs. The Base58 implementation uses BigInt over arrays and the entry point imports local .mjs files.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The main actor wrote all files directly into /output and the artifact validator later found pybytes.mjs, cli.mjs, test15.mjs, and the base58 module files with expected entry test15.mjs present.
parallel.verification: Ran the executable for sample and edge cases, then compared Node output against the executable for nine valid cases and checked missing-argument and --name=value behavior. One missing-argument diff remained on program name but was accepted by the agent as expected.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator completed and failed the solution at 67/102. The accessible evidence does not include per-hidden-case failures; visible local evidence shows at least an accepted stderr program-name difference on missing-argument behavior.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same migration requirements: pure Node.js ESM, local .mjs module split, manual argv parsing, Base58 encode/decode equivalence, Python bytes repr output, output under /output, and no external packages.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single main serial actor handled executable probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final response without delegation or child-agent activity.
serial.implementation: Wrote a four-file structure: lib/base58.mjs, lib/pybytes.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and test15.mjs. The Base58 implementation uses manual array-based base conversion and the entry point catches decode errors with a simplified ValueError-style stderr line.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The main actor wrote the local modules and entry point into /output, and the artifact validator found test15.mjs plus the three lib/*.mjs files with the expected entry present.
serial.verification: Ran the executable for behavior probes, verified all four prompt samples with Node output, then diffed selected edge cases including empty strings, Unicode, control bytes, and leading-zero decode, reporting ALL_MATCH for those selected cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator completed and failed the solution at 67/102. The accessible pair evidence does not expose the exact hidden failing cases; visible local verification did not cover enough behavior to pass the full suite.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status evaluations make this a both_fail pair: both parallel-mode and serial attempts passed 67 of 102 official cases and solution_passed is false. The concrete task-solving contrast is ordinary implementation and verification variation, not a parallel coordination difference. The parallel-mode run had a swarm-mode system reminder but declined delegation and status confirms no executed subagents, so the official failure cannot be attributed to a child-agent boundary. Both runs locally verified selected valid and edge cases but left hidden official failures unresolved.
parallel_contributors: Parallel-mode wrote a direct seven-file implementation and locally accepted a missing-argument stderr program-name difference as expected.
Parallel-mode did not execute a child-agent or multi-agent mechanism, so no concurrency-specific process contributor is evidenced.
serial_contributors: Serial wrote a direct four-file implementation and locally verified selected prompt and edge cases.
Serial also failed the official hidden suite at the same 67/102 level, so it did not provide a passing control implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a BigInt-based Base58 module split into alphabet, UTF-8, encode, decode, bytes repr, CLI, and entry files; serial used a compact lib/base58.mjs plus lib/pybytes.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and entry.
Parallel left invalid Base58 character handling to its decode helper and Node error behavior; serial caught decode errors and printed a simplified ValueError-style line.
Both local verification sets were selected by the agent and did not cover enough official cases to pass.
evaluator_effects: The accessible evaluation summaries provide only aggregate 67/102 results and no per-test failure list, so the exact hidden testcase failures cannot be reconstructed from the allowed inputs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported process comparison but no concurrency-specific causal label
